snippet.title: CORE | Bipolar Q&A | Mary Peltz & Kim Wessel | June 16, 2021
snippet.description:
C.O.R.E. Programs presents Understanding ADHD and Bipolar
The information given is to help support and bring understanding and healing to families and individuals. Kim Wessel is a RN of 22 years and is very experienced in dealing with these two issues. Mary Peltz is a facilitator of CORE classes and has studied neurobiology.
This Q&A session covers Bipolar more in depth than it does ADHD
